as_told.title: Robert Maxwell, Nazi scientists and Pergamon Press

plain: The British media owner Robert Maxwell, whom Michels calls an "MI6 guy," questioned Nazi scientists in Germany after World War II, Michels says, adding that few people know it. On a later episode he tells it again, adds that Maxwell went on to own Pergamon Press, a scientific publisher, and credits the journalist Whitney Webb's book One Nation Under Blackmail. He raises it because it would tie a spy-linked businessman to both German wartime science and the publishing of research.
